youtube_title: Holding Your Pee For Hours? Bad Idea | Body Fix #19 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #19. Office, traffic, road trip... and you've been HOLDING your pee for hours?
B is right. It raises INFECTION risk. Bacteria get time to grow.
Peeing flushes bacteria out. Hold it + drink less = higher UTI risk.
Fix: Go when you need to, drink enough water, keep good hygiene.
Red flags: Burning, fever, back pain or blood in urine? See a DOCTOR soon.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - UTI prevention
